title: epsilon-delta widget config
description: The JSON body of ```{anywidget} …/widgets/epsilon-delta.mjs (docs/plan/05 §5.8, widgets/README.md): the graph of f near a, the band |y − L| < ε, the window 0 < |x − a| < δ, an ε slider with the largest δ on each side, and a δ slider with a verdict. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (ranges increasing, a strictly inside xRange, L inside yRange, eps inside epsRange, delta and epsStep small enough, the names in f) are checked by scripts/check_widgets.py and widgets/_lib/epsdelta.mjs.

f.description: The function of x, in the expression language of widgets/README.md (the same as function-plot's).

a.description: The point x approaches. It must lie strictly inside xRange.

L.description: The claimed limit: the centre of the ε-band. It must lie inside yRange. A wrong L is allowed (the widget then finds no δ for small ε).

epsRange.description: [min, max] of the ε slider, both > 0.

epsStep.description: The step of the ε slider (default: the epsRange width / 100). Choose it so that the values a Try this asks for are on the grid.

delta.description: The starting value of the reader's δ (> 0; default: half the distance from a to the nearer end of xRange, which is also the δ slider's maximum).

xRange.description: [min, max] of the x-axis shown at first. The largest δ is searched up to its ends.

yRange.description: [min, max] of the y-axis shown at first.

functions.description: The functions an expression may call: the same list as function-plot.schema.json (a test keeps the two equal).

constants.description: The constants an expression may use (expression.mjs CONSTANTS).
